notes.title: Price drop and Switch release meow!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30354543/08169ef34a1caf6de1baaf653472cb1dfc2ce2bc.gif

Hello everyone!

We have a very good mews for you! As some of you might have noticed, starting today MagiCat got a purrmanent price drop from $7.99 to $4.99. This is not a discount or any kind of special deals, but a purrmanent change that will hopefully open the door of this game to many other humans and cats all around the world.

Why the sudden decision you ask? Because, as we have mewntioned in the previous announcement, MagiCat just celebrated its first anniversary on Steam, and just got released on Nintendo Switch today!

There's nothing different between both versions, so you can choose either version without having to worry getting left out from the other.

Thank you so much for your support until now, and enjoy your adventure meow!

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.notes:
Ver 1.10
- Added Check Point on the beginning of each stage-part
- Reduce Boss phase to just 4 phase (You can still fight 5 phase boss on New Game+)

I hope with this update, the frustrating part of the game is reduced.

Also some minor fix...
- Fix bug where you can still get damaged even after defeating the boss
- Fix bug where you can't jump from fence if using up on analog



Thanks for your support, keep the feedback coming meow~

notes.title: 1.03 - Update so far
notes.notes:
Ver 1.01 
- Fix nodash indication

Ver 1.02 
- Reduce display memory usage
- Add Russian Keyboard Layout support
- Reset PAW needed for revive upon entering boss room
- Some stage design change

Ver 1.03
- Retain gem even if the stage is restarted (but lost on quit)
- Leaving a stage on Check Point now give you bonus
- Item on map is now auto-use
- Fix char getting damage when stomping at enemies
- Some stage design change
